asr.full_text: MUSIC OK. To summarise it. There is 2 billion people around the world that doesn't have a bank account today. That creates a massive market and a very big needs for a banking industry for these people. There are a lot of people who don't understand the concept. And I think, they are more afraid. And if we let go of the fear, we are able to invite something else here. So when someone presents something new to you, the fear is here, let that go. And then, what's here? Why does someone just shut the door? It's very tightly connected to emotions. Because if you don't understand your emotions you're just going to react to something whether you have the information or not. Now I think it's important to loosen yourself away from the negative people and just focus on the positivity because positivity will eventually hit the skeptics as well. Through cryptocurrency, we will engage all these people through the cell phones, and that enables transactions for many people. If we just break it down to the OneCoin business, what we're doing right now, we are creating this distribution through network marketing. I think it's very important to distribute the right information. I mean we have see many times especially in the network marketing business people saying whatever they need to sell. I think ONE COIN is different because we don't have to sell. Which is very smart because since this is an information-driven business, it's very important to have the network marketing ... Marketing. Why? Because I can always meet you and answer the questions you have, and if we do it in the right way through information, you will always get people in the world to get access to banking, which they don't have today, I think we are making the world a better place. And I think we were right because today a lot of big banks and a lot of financial institutes are writing about this blockchain technique in the media and wants to implement it one way or another. I mean, it's never too late to start all over. You can do that every day. So many of us don't have enough self-worth, and we're all so special. We're spirits having a physical experience and we're so powerful. And we're not even experiencing 10% of our capabilities. We were taught very early, go to school, get a good education, get a good secure job, stay there. But what we see right now is so many things is happening in society and a lot of people don't experience that secure work anymore and if you are not willing to change the way you have been brought up and the way you have been brought up to think it's gonna be very challenging. Allow yourself to be curious and then develop from that curiosity the trust and from there do the decision making. Because we are building this new system on trust. Just to know that Dr. Roosha, with her competence, is behind the company in controlling growth and usability makes it very confident for me to actually be a part of one coin, because we don't need to sell anything, we just need to go out there inform people about opportunity to be a part of a new cryptocurrency, and the most important thing to talk about is when the other cryptocurrencies is just talking about making a profit. We are actually talking about the usability, and reach to the mass market.

textual.observation: The description invites viewers to join OneCoin through a signup URL, while the speaker presents OneCoin as providing banking access to people without bank accounts.

evidence.quote: you will always get people in the world to get access to banking, which they don't have today

textual.context: Promotional context is indicated by the signup invitation and the speaker's positive presentation of OneCoin.
textual.potential_relevance: The requested free signup is linked to a stated opportunity involving banking access for people without bank accounts (DESCRIPTION_0001: "Join Free https://www.onecoin.eu/signup/Oslo2016."; ASR_0002: "get access to banking, which they don't have today").
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that signup provides banking access, that enrollment occurred, or that any financial outcome resulted.

textual.observation: The speaker describes OneCoin distribution through network marketing and asks people to inform others about an opportunity to join a new cryptocurrency.

evidence.quote: we are creating this distribution through network marketing
we just need to go out there inform people about opportunity to be a part of a new cryptocurrency

textual.context: The statements are promotional and recruitment-oriented; the speaker characterizes the activity as information-driven.
textual.potential_relevance: The action of informing others is linked to a stated opportunity to join a cryptocurrency through network marketing (ASR_0001: "distribution through network marketing"; ASR_0002: "opportunity to be a part of a new cryptocurrency").
textual.limitations: The records do not establish compensation, required payment, recruitment terms, actual enrollment, or any resulting benefit.

textual.observation: The speaker attributes confidence in joining OneCoin to Dr. Roosha's claimed competence and role behind the company.

evidence.quote: Dr. Roosha, with her competence, is behind the company in controlling growth and usability
makes it very confident for me to actually be a part of one coin

textual.context: This is a first-person endorsement linking the claimed company backing to the speaker's decision to participate.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed expert/company affiliation is linked to the speaker's stated decision to join OneCoin (ASR_0002: "makes it very confident for me to actually be a part of one coin").
textual.limitations: The records do not verify Dr. Roosha's identity, qualifications, role, or the company's stated claims.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker explicitly frames the activity as information-sharing rather than selling while also describing network marketing.
The speaker encourages listeners to let go of fear and distance themselves from negative people when considering the new system.

evidence.quote: if we let go of the fear
loosen yourself away from the negative people

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a payment and cryptocurrency opportunity and directs viewers to join through a signup URL. It presents network-marketing distribution and encourages viewers to recruit or inform others about the opportunity, including claimed access to banking for people without bank accounts. The records do not establish that signup produced banking access, that payment was required, or that enrollment or financial loss occurred.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker explicitly identifies network marketing as the distribution mechanism and encourages informing other people about the opportunity. This grounds a recruitment-oriented network-marketing mechanism under S06, although the supplied evidence does not specify commissions, downlines, tiers, or income dependence on recruitment.
